middleware.name: metricsMiddleware
middleware.detail: Counts and times every request by route pattern

middleware.name: rateLimitMiddleware
middleware.detail: Per-IP token bucket: 10 req/s, burst 30, 429 when empty

middleware.name: gzipMiddleware
middleware.detail: Gzips responses when the client accepts it

metrics.name: http_requests_total
metrics.help: Total HTTP requests by route, method and status.

metrics.name: http_request_duration_seconds
metrics.help: HTTP request duration by route and method.

metrics.name: feed_refresh_total
metrics.help: GTFS-RT feed refresh attempts by feed group and result.

metrics.name: feed_last_refresh_timestamp_seconds
metrics.help: Unix time of the last successful refresh, per feed group.

metrics.name: alerts_entities
metrics.help: Alerts currently cached from the MTA alerts feed.

metrics.name: alerts_labeled
metrics.help: Cached alerts carrying a readable Mercury label.

metrics.name: plan_no_route_total
metrics.help: Plan requests that returned zero journeys.

metrics.name: account_purge_last_success_timestamp_seconds
metrics.help: Unix time of the last fully successful account and token purge.

metrics.name: rate_limited_total
metrics.help: Requests rejected by the per-IP rate limiter.

machines.label: nyc-subway-db
machines.detail: Fly Postgres app in ewr on a 1 GB volume, with volume snapshots kept 5 days. The API reaches it through the DATABASE_URL secret.

services.label: Vercel
services.detail: Builds every push with vercel.json buildCommand, serves dist/ and the SPA rewrite. Production alias localexpress.nyc.

services.label: Namecheap DNS
services.detail: Registrar and DNS for localexpress.nyc (expires 2027-09-02). The send. subdomain holds the Resend sending records.

services.label: Fly managed Grafana
services.detail: Dashboard grafana/nyc-subway-api.json over the same Prometheus. No alerting; rules run in CI.

services.label: GitHub Actions
services.detail: Tests, Fly deploy, scheduled metrics and feed checks; opens issues when a check fails.
